content.short: Moniepoint is a leading African business banking and payments platform, Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer.
content.description: Moniepoint is one of Africa's largest business banking and payments platforms, serving millions of small and medium businesses mainly in Nigeria and now expanding into Kenya. It provides business and personal bank accounts, a vast network of POS terminals and agents, payment acceptance, working-capital loans, and expense and inventory tools that help merchants run and grow. Moniepoint has become Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, with more than ten million accounts and around 17 billion dollars in monthly transaction volume, and through MonieWorld it is building cross-border services for the diaspora. Its reliable payment infrastructure and accounts sit at the heart of everyday African commerce.
content.meta: Moniepoint powers business banking, POS and payments for African SMEs. Discover Moniepoint and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
